common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.apiUnreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check that the application is running.

auth.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.

register.title: Sign up
register.intro: An account lets you rate the content of the articles.

install.title: Install your website
install.intro: Welcome! Fill in your event details and create the administrator account. You can change everything later.

users.intro: Assign the roles of each account. Any logged-in account can rate article blocks.

media.intro: Images are converted to WebP and resized to keep the website light. They can be reused in every article.

upload.title: Add an image
upload.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB max.
upload.done: Image added to the media library.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

datasets.intro: Import CSV files, check that the system understood each variable, then validate them to use them in charts. File contents are never copied into the database: only the link to the source is kept.
datasets.name: Data set name
datasets.sourceFile: Source: CSV file uploaded to the server.

import.title: Import a data set
import.format: Expected format: a header line with the variable names, then one line per individual; fields separated by semicolons (;).
import.fileHint: 5 MB max. UTF-8 or Windows (Excel) encoding.
import.urlHint: Direct link to a public CSV, such as an open data portal export. It will be read again regularly.

variables.title: Variables
variables.intro: Check each variable: the suggested type was detected automatically. A numerical variable is a quantity (axis, value, size); a categorical variable is used to group (legend, categories). An identifier such as a bib number is categorical.
variables.lockedIntro: This data set is validated: types are locked because charts may use them. Labels can still be edited.
variables.label: Displayed label
variables.validated: Data set validated: it can now be used in charts.
variables.fixErrors: Fix the errors reported on the variables.

charts.dataError: The data of this chart could not be loaded.
charts.mappingError: This chart no longer matches its data set (a column has disappeared).
charts.intro: Charts can be reused in every dashboard article.

editor.title: Chart title
editor.descriptionHint: What the chart shows, in one or two sentences. It is read by screen readers.
editor.noDataset: No validated data set: ask a data provider to import one.
editor.previewHint: Choose a data set and the required variables to see the preview.

bar.name: Bar chart
bar.help: Compares a quantity across categories (e.g. spectators per stage).

line.name: Line chart
line.help: Shows a change along an ordered axis (e.g. sales per week).

pie.name: Pie chart
pie.help: Shows the share of each category in a total.

histogram.name: Histogram
histogram.help: Shows the distribution of a numerical variable (e.g. runners’ times).

scatter.name: Scatter plot
scatter.help: Shows the relation between two numerical variables.

heatmap.name: Heatmap
heatmap.help: Shows an intensity at the crossing of two categories (e.g. day × time slot).

articles.title: Title

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.help: Data story: at least one chart to be published.

articles.noBlocks: No blocks: add a heading, a text, an image or a chart.
articles.chartsInDashboards: Charts are only available in dashboard articles.
articles.fixErrors: Fix the reported errors before saving.
articles.markdownHint: **bold**, *italic*, [link](https://…), lists with “- ”, blank line between paragraphs.
articles.caption: Caption
